# AIR Blackbox

> Open-source EU AI Act compliance scanner for Python AI agents

AIR Blackbox is an open-source CLI tool that scans Python AI agent code for EU AI Act compliance gaps. It runs 45+ checks across Articles 9-15, including prompt injection detection, GDPR scanning, bias/fairness analysis, and ISO 42001 + NIST AI RMF crosswalk. It supports trust layers for 7 frameworks: LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, OpenAI SDK, Claude Agent SDK, Google ADK, and Haystack.

## Installation

pip install air-blackbox

## Quick Start

air-blackbox comply --scan . -v

## Features

- 45+ EU AI Act compliance checks (Articles 9-15)
- Prompt injection detection (20 patterns, 5 categories)
- GDPR scanner (8 checks)
- Bias and fairness scanner (6 checks)
- ISO 42001 + NIST AI RMF standards crosswalk
- Agent-to-agent (A2A) compliance protocol
- HMAC-SHA256 tamper-evident audit chains
- Trust layers for 7 frameworks
- Pre-commit hooks
- Evidence bundle exporter
- MCP server integration
